name: tiny-menaces
description: A transparent desktop overlay game for Tiny Menaces.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-ui.cjs
scripts.build:creator: npm run build -w @tiny-menaces/shared && npm run build -w @tiny-menaces/character-creator
scripts.generate:mocks: npm run build:creator && npm run generate:mocks -w @tiny-menaces/character-creator
